# mailtrap_api_token (Resource)

Manages a Mailtrap API token. The API has no update endpoint, so every configuration change forces replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mailtrap_account" "example" {}

resource "mailtrap_api_token" "example" {
  name = "ci-token"

  resources = [{
    resource_type = "account"
    resource_id   = data.mailtrap_account.example.id
    access_level  = 100
  }]
}

# The full token value. Only available when the token is created by
# Terraform (never returned again by the API).
output "token" {
  value     = mailtrap_api_token.example.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the API token. Changing this forces replacement.

### Optional

- `resources` (Attributes List) Permissions granted to the token. Changing this forces replacement. Drift in permissions made outside Terraform is not detected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))

### Read-Only

- `created_by` (String) User or token that created this token.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 expiry timestamp, or null if the token does not expire.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the API token.
- `last_4_digits` (String) Last four characters of the token value.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Full token value. Returned only on creation; unavailable for imported tokens.

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Required:

- `access_level` (Number) Access level granted on the resource.
- `resource_id` (Number) ID of the resource the permission applies to.
- `resource_type` (String) Kind of resource the permission applies to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an API token by its numeric ID. The full token value cannot be
# recovered on import; it is only returned by the API on creation.
terraform import mailtrap_api_token.example 12345
```
